messages:
nina: heads-up from orion-lite-v3 int8 onboarding: mixed Mongolian + Hebrew snippets are being split into sub-tokens and we see punctuation dropped in the beam results. small but reproducible on zh/ja/mon->en evals. sample below.
jorge: paste sample + tokenizer output pls
nina: ```
INPUT: "ᠮᠣᠩᠭᠣᠯ שלום and Tokyo。"
TOKENIZER OUT: ["ᠮ", "ᠣ", "ᠩᠭᠣᠯ", " ", "ש", "ל", "ו", "ם", " ", "and", " ", "Tokyo", "。"]
EXPECTED TOKENS: ["ᠮᠣᠩᠭᠣᠯ", " ", "שלום", " ", "and", " ", "Tokyo", "。"]
OBS: Mongolian grapheme split into leading single-codepoint tokens; Hebrew cluster split char-by-char; final ideographic punctuation sometimes lost in beam.
BLEU DIFF (fp16 -> int8): -0.95 on mixedscript-locale-smoke
```
eval-bot: run=run-4412, model=orion-lite-v3-int8, dataset=mixedscript-locale-smoke, metrics={bleu:-0.95, chrF:-0.12}, anomalies={mon-grapheme-splits:8, heb-cluster-frag:11, punctuation-drop:4}
sana: we haven't changed tokenizer for Mongolian recently. did runtime change packing again? small zero-point shift can amplify beam fragility when tokens fragment.
jorge: i'll run a quick bisect on the int8 packing artifacts and compare token-id histograms vs fp16 baseline. canary freeze if needed.
nina: quick experiment: force NFC normalization + run pre-token grapheme-cluster join for Mongolian+Hebrew -> splits disappear, BLEU improves to -0.18 on the smoke. so preproc helps but we should find root cause.
runtime-bot: bisect started: suspect commit=ac4d2b (embed-shard reorder), p=0.003; artifact: https://ci.redwood/bisect/orion/4412 (internal)
jorge: i'll open a detector that fails builds when sentence-level token-id histogram KL divergence vs fp16 > 0.02. also prototyping embedding-offset-pad to keep id alignment stable across quant variants.
sana: short-term: add the NFC+grapheme join preproc to devex pipeline for int8 canary and add locale-suite unit that includes Mongolian+Hebrew+CJK mixed cases.
nina: assigning: jorge (bisect + detector + embed-pad PoC), sana (preproc PR + unit tests), i'll gather failing samples and ping support if any customers report.
jorge: noted, will update here by EOD. :white_check_mark:
summary: Orion-lite-v3 int8 onboarding found mixed Mongolian+Hebrew token fragmentation and punctuation loss; short-term mitigation: NFC normalization + grapheme-cluster join; long-term: bisect implicates embed shard reorder, add token-id histogram KL detector and embedding-offset padding; unit tests for mixed-script locale-suite.
